findings.evidence: The roadmap specifies `Slope (T : BoundaryTorus)` and `slopeEquiv (T : FramedBoundaryTorus)` at README lines 538–555. Here grep finds only `def Slope : Type := Quotient slopeSetoid` at line 125 and `def slopeEquiv : Slope ≃ OnePoint ℚ` at line 219, while no `FramedBoundaryTorus` declaration exists in `code/TauCeti`.
findings.fix: First define the required boundary-torus/homology object and `Slope T` from primitive classes in `H₁(T; ℤ)` modulo sign; define meridian, longitude, coordinate maps, and `slopeEquiv` only from an explicit `FramedBoundaryTorus`.
findings.issue: `Slope` is the sign quotient of primitive pairs in `ℤ × ℤ`, so it depends on the silently chosen meridian-longitude coordinates; consequently `Slope.meridian`, `Slope.longitude`, `Slope.value`, and `slopeEquiv` are globally canonical despite being framing-dependent. This does not model a slope on a torus basis-freely.

summary: The claimed basis-free slope type is already coordinatized by a framing, so the central roadmap distinction is not formalized.
